entities.name: Louis-Marie-Joseph-Eusèbe Caverot

entities.summary: Louis-Marie Caverot was a French prelate of the Catholic Church who became a bishop in 1849 and served as Archbishop of Lyon from 1876 to 1887. He was raised to the rank of cardinal in 1877.
